answer: Like a living willow whose roots weave soil into mutual stability, agents bind identity to an evolving web-of-trust stake. Carving a fake peerage is no swift chisel on soft chalk; consensus treats unproven nodes like an untested relic, demanding bonded capital that scales with superlinear attacker cost. A solitary Sybil cannot mimic dense communal rings: multiplying deceit requires an exponentially heavier pledge, hard and immovable as marble.
